text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- The defeat of PRI eliminates one-party system in Mexico
- NATO to decide today in Madrid its expansion into Eastern Europa
- (Kidnapped) Ortega Lara has been here for 532 days
- Basque Justice orders Otegi's arrest
EL MUNDO
- Clinton will fix today NATO's new military borders
- Eight minutes in ETA's gulag
- Families said courts responsible for Otegi's escape - they let him go
ABC
- Ortega Lara was buried alive here for 532 days
CINCO DIAS
- European commission puts Spain in "third gear", for the telecommunication liberalisation.
- (Santander's chairman) Botin said it (Santander) has an insignificant stake in Argentaria
EXPANSION
- Spain among the five European countries with lowest inflation
- Bourse hit a new record high
- Santander forecasts it will make $400 million profit in Latin America.
- (Caja Madrid's chairman) Miguel Blesa will enter Telefonica's board as independent.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- OECD calls for Iberia's immediate privatisation
- Swiss Glencore to launch a bid of 27 billion pesetas for Asturiana de Zinc
- Santander's group to list its Latam banks in the coming months
